column1: # Phase 5e bridge compile classpath, pinned against the frozen Phase 5b WAR.
# Every entry is extracted from build/phase5d/legacy-webui/webui.war, which
# here is resolved from a repository, so ZK 3.6 never enters reproducible
# dependency resolution and never reaches the modern runtime.
# WEB-INF/classes/ is a tree. Its pin is a SHA-512 over the sorted
# "<relative-name>\0<sha512-of-content>\n" records of every class entry, so it
# is a digest of the code rather than of a particular zip encoder.
